_comment: ADR 0015 Gate 1 cumulative arms on the deterministic 6% user pilot.
Every cell uses the same seed, users, three epochs, and 4096 shared random
negatives. The reduced negative count keeps the five-arm laptop run bounded;
the 2026-08-30 sweep found no recall loss versus 16384 on this pilot.
The first three cells disable both v2 architectural additions so they isolate
temperature. The fourth and fifth add hard negatives, then side features.
